translation: matter-codex: control menu. Choose a section with the buttons below.
The detailed result was sent as a private Mattermost response. This action can include device-code data, so the channel card only shows that the action ran.
Use buttons for flow start, pending decisions, repositories, accounts, profiles, prompts, runtime, and system. Typed commands remain available as the fallback interface.

Developer-review flow start area. A button wizard for repository, profile, and task text selection will come in the next UX stage; for now this section links to the dependent sections and pending decisions.
Check repository/profile settings or move to pending decisions.
Owner decisions currently live in flow cards with approve/reject buttons. Waiting and blocked flow lists will be added directly in this section in the next UX stage.
Open flow start or check related settings.

Repositories connect the Git provider, Mattermost channel, and webhook. The buttons below show stored repositories and quick checks for the current matter-codex repository; adding an arbitrary repository will move to a dialog.
Check the list, GitHub token access, or webhook.
An agent profile can use different OpenAI and GitHub accounts. Choose the account type below.
OpenAI uses device-code auth, GitHub tokens are provided by the owner.

Codex CLI is authorized through the Mattermost device-code flow, without a raw API key. Use the buttons below to list accounts, start authorization for `primary`, and check the device code. Custom account names will use a Mattermost dialog in the next step.
Create an account, open the link, enter the code, then run status again.
GitHub accounts can differ between agent profiles. The owner chooses scopes when creating the token. Use the buttons below to list accounts and run quick checks for the current repository.
Check token access and webhook state for the target repository.
A profile binds the agent role, OpenAI account, GitHub account, and prompt templates. The buttons below show seeded profiles and open related accounts/prompts.
Check available roles and bound accounts.
Prompt templates are stored in PostgreSQL and edited from Mattermost. The buttons below show templates, placeholder help, and a reviewer test render; full Markdown editing will use a dialog.
Open the list, help, or test render.
Runtime manages Kubernetes Job/PVC resources for smoke, dev, review, and flow runs. The buttons below start a safe smoke run and a retention cleanup dry-run without deleting resources.
Start a smoke run or dry-run cleanup.
System checks and settings. The buttons below show health, safe token/storage status, and switch the interface locale.
The menu covers the primary button-driven UX. Choose a section below; fallback typed help remains available only through manual input.
Open a section or go back.
Show the developer-review flow command shape.
Show pending decisions and flow cards.
Repository add and GitHub webhook setup.
OpenAI and GitHub accounts for agent profiles.
GitHub token, scopes, and gh workflow.
Start device-code authorization for OpenAI account primary.
Show the link and code or finish primary authorization.
Check GitHub token access to codex-k8s/matter-codex.
Create or update webhook for codex-k8s/matter-codex.
Open a form for adding a repository.
Open a form for changing repository metadata.
Open a confirmation form for deleting repository metadata.
Show seeded agent profiles and bound accounts.
Show placeholders for reviewer review_pr template.
Start a short Kubernetes smoke run.
Show a retention cleanup preview without deleting resources.
Show safe token and storage status.

`/agents repo add github owner/name [default-branch]` - add repository metadata and repo-channel
`/agents github check owner/name` - check GitHub repo access
`/agents github branch dry-run owner/name branch [base]` - validate branch creation without changes
`/agents github branch create owner/name branch [base]` - create branch from base
`/agents github pr dry-run owner/name head base title...` - validate PR parameters without creation
`/agents github pr status owner/name number` - show PR status/reviews/comments
`/agents github webhook ensure owner/name` - register repo webhook
`/agents token check` - show safe token and storage status
`/agents openai auth|status|list|cleanup` - authorize a Codex/OpenAI account via device code
`/agents profile list` - show seed agent profiles
`/agents prompt help|list|show|render|set` - manage editable agent prompt templates
`/agents locale get|set en|ru` - show or change bot response locale
`/agents runtime smoke|status|cleanup|prune` - create, inspect, and clean Kubernetes runner resources
`/agents dev smoke|status|cleanup` - run a Codex developer agent smoke task
`/agents review pr|status|cleanup` - run a Codex reviewer agent for an existing PR
`/agents flow start|status|card|cleanup` - developer-review loop with auto-review, owner gate, and fix attempts
